title: B1 Citizenship Capstone: Állampolgárság és alkotmányos alapismeretek
grammar: Grand capstone synthesis of the entire 36-unit Hungarian citizenship curriculum

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can say how Hungarian citizenship is acquired, which rights and duties citizens have, and what the oath is.
I can review the rights, duties and exam topics of the citizenship track.
Read the grand compendium on Hungarian citizenship and the solemn oath.
I can answer simple questions about citizenship that could come up at an interview.
